Taylor Morgan: Quick sync — post-launch plan proposal: 48h hotfix window for P0/P1, then a 2-week follow-on sprint with 50% bug slots / 50% enhancements. Try to keep hotfixes to <8 engineering hours each.
Rina Das: +1 for the 48h window. Suggest we reserve 1 hotfix slot per day for sales-protected customer fixes.
Leo Ortiz: Ops note: we'll need to pause autoscaler experiments for the 48h window. OpsBot: scheduled pause for 72h starting on deploy.
Taylor Morgan: Good. Define P0 = outage/data-loss, P1 = paid-customer blocking regression, P2 = cosmetic. Rina can you tag current tickets?
Rina Das: Done. Labels added: customer-driven, hotfix-candidate, p0, p1, p2. See board: https://redwood.atlassian.net/boards/AFTR
QA-Runner: Nightly snapshot: embed-p95 = 130ms (baseline 115ms). Flag: 3 failing embed-e2e tests.
Leo Ortiz: Canary playbook (short): ```
- deploy hotfix to canary cluster
- run smoke: embed + login + onboarding
- wait 30m for metrics
- if error-rate > 0.5% or embed-p95 > 1.5x baseline -> rollback
```
Taylor Morgan: Action items: Rina update tickets with dev-estimates (T-shirt + hours), QA-Runner run focused smoke for hotfix candidates and post results, Leo schedule canary and rollback doc. Reconvene 24h. :thumbsup:
